blessedUnder.note: Match required on glVersion string. A mismatch means mesa was upgraded on this VM -- re-bless with --bless, do not treat a mismatch alone as a regression.

productionConfig.note: Q01: mirror of the orangepi preset (constrained_renderer_config.cpp:307, zone budget 20, count mode). Consumed by BOTH scripts/ci/visual_gate.py (run_benchmark) and scripts/pi/ (pi_common.py) so the harness measures what production actually ships instead of full per-pixel lighting. The orangepi preset's object budget (10) is NOT mirrored here -- meaningful only with --objects, which the harness doesn't pass (out of scope, would change scene content). Do NOT add these flags to any zone's extraArgs -- pi_common.build_pose_args asserts extraArgs contains only --camera-pose entries. Q03: --player-light-level replaces the benchmark's old fixed-attenuation lamp fixture with a production-mirrored lightstone (renderer_entities.cpp), including the x3 color boost the shader receives (renderer_sim_bridge.cpp:745) and the per-vertex slot-0 fill that lights demoted regions. Level 9 = Greater Lightstone (TypeToLevel, light_source.h) -- the best practical in-game light per Will; level 10 is Globe of Stars.

zones.description: H02b re-frame: city/outdoor, static representative poses picked via --pose-search (region-anchored candidate scoring) after the H02 orbit-path frames were rejected for showing fog/ground/sky with no city geometry.

frameDescriptions.1: Courtyard facing a tiled-roof building entrance framed by ivy-covered walls
frameDescriptions.2: Interior temple/building room: mosaic-tiled walls, stone pillars, vaulted ceiling

zones.description: H02b re-frame: forest/organic, static representative poses picked via --pose-search after the H02 orbit-path frames were rejected for clipping through a tree. Poses sit on real elven treehouse platforms (region-anchored candidates), not embedded in trunks or rock.

frameDescriptions.1: Close-up gazebo rooftop on a treehouse platform, wooden bridges connecting to neighboring platforms
frameDescriptions.2: Elevated wooden bridge walkway connecting elven treehouse platforms, forest canopy behind

zones.description: H02b re-frame: dungeon interior (undead crypt), static representative poses picked via --pose-search after the H02 orbit-path frames were rejected for viewing the crypt from outside its shell. All three poses sit inside crypt rooms/halls (region-anchored candidates), not outside the geometry. blackburrow and crushbone remain rejected substitutes -- see H02 review for that investigation (unchanged in this unit).

frameDescriptions.0: Crypt altar/pillar room with checkerboard floor, wooden-lattice walls, staircase in background
frameDescriptions.1: Crypt doorway/archway opening onto a stone-railed hall with checkerboard floor
frameDescriptions.2: Crypt balcony hall: checkerboard floor and stone balustrade railing under a vaulted ceiling
